cover.caption: Den vakre jenta i treet over kilden kunne ikke si et ord.
cover.alt: Ei vakker jente med langt, lyst hår sitter på en grein i et høyt tre over en klar kilde og ser ansiktet sitt i vannet. På himmelen over trærne ser man en stjerne, en blek måne og sola som står opp.

Picture: The Maiden sits silent on a broad branch of the tall oak over the Forest Spring in the pearly dawn, her long ash-blonde hair falling loose, looking down at her own lovely face mirrored in the still water. In the pale sky above the treetops hang a single silver star, a fading white moon and the first gold of the rising sun.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Maiden: A lovely young woman of about eighteen with a heart-shaped face, a small nose, large grey-green eyes and a gentle, wistful mouth. Her long ash-blonde hair falls to her waist, held back by a coral-pink ribbon. She wears a simple peach-coloured dress with a laced rose-brown bodice, little brown shoes and a tiny silver christening cross on a cord round her neck.

Setting:
- the Forest Spring: A small, perfectly clear spring in a ring of mossy stones and ferns, still as a mirror, in a quiet clearing of a great spruce-and-birch forest. A tall old oak with broad, spreading branches leans right over the water. Through the trees on one side rise the grey stone towers and steep dark roofs of a castle close by.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in and around a great, dark forest of spruce and birch. The poor couple live in a tiny log cottage deep in the forest. The foster mother's house is big, quiet and whitewashed; along its longest corridor stand three tall, heavy doors of dark oak. Behind them wait a small, sharp silver-white star, a big, round, cold white moon and a small, blazing golden sun. Far off through the forest, a clear spring lies under a tall old oak, close to a castle of grey stone with steep dark roofs and a queen's bedchamber with a carved wooden cradle. The babies are wrapped in white linen.

Accents: the deep blue of the foster mother's veil and the apricot of the queen's gown.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria (fostermoren)
characters.description: En mild, velkledd frue som tar barnet som foster­mor, setter forbudte rom som prøve, og vender tilbake for å straffe og til slutt tilgi.
characters.look: A tall, slender, serene woman of about thirty-five with an oval face, calm dark-brown eyes, a straight nose, softly arched dark brows and a gentle, grave smile. Her dark hair is hidden under a long deep-blue veil that falls to her shoulders. She wears a long cream-white gown with a band of silver embroidery at the hem, a deep-blue mantle fastened at the throat with a small silver lily brooch, and soft grey leather shoes.

characters.name: Jenta som liten
characters.description: Jenta som vokser opp hos fostermoren i det store, stille huset, og som ikke klarer å la være å kikke inn i rommene hun ikke får gå inn i.
characters.look: A small girl of about eight with a heart-shaped face, a button nose, big curious grey-green eyes, rosy cheeks and long ash-blonde hair in a single plait tied with a coral-pink ribbon. She wears a simple peach-coloured dress with long sleeves, a white pinafore and little brown shoes, and a tiny silver christening cross on a cord round her neck.

characters.name: Jenta
characters.description: Jenta når hun er nesten voksen. Hun velger å bli den vakreste av alle kvinner, men fra den dagen kan hun ikke si et eneste ord.
characters.look: A lovely young woman of about eighteen with a heart-shaped face, a small nose, large grey-green eyes and a gentle, wistful mouth. Her long ash-blonde hair falls to her waist, held back by a coral-pink ribbon. She wears a simple peach-coloured dress with a laced rose-brown bodice, little brown shoes and a tiny silver christening cross on a cord round her neck.

characters.name: Den unge dronningen
characters.description: En fattig jente som vokser opp hos en streng, men god foster­mor; hun blir uvanlig vakker, men mister stemmen og blir senere dronning.
characters.look: A lovely young queen of about twenty with a heart-shaped face, a small nose, large grey-green eyes and a gentle, sorrowful mouth, and long ash-blonde hair flowing down her back under a slender silver crown set with small pearls. She wears a long apricot gown with wide sleeves and silver embroidery at the neckline over a cream underdress, grey felt slippers and a tiny silver christening cross at her throat.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: Arvingen til slottet som finner den vakre, stumme jenta ved kilden og kjemper for å få henne til dronning.
characters.look: A tall, easy-going young prince of about twenty-four with a long, open face, a strong nose, warm hazel eyes that crinkle when he smiles, wavy light-brown hair swept back to his collar and a short, neatly trimmed light-brown beard. He wears a knee-length teal-blue coat with a row of small silver buttons over a dove-grey shirt, charcoal breeches, black riding boots and a narrow silver circlet.

characters.name: Den gamle dronningen
characters.description: Prinsens mor, mistenksom og streng, som tror den stumme dronningen er farlig, men som til slutt blir forsonet.
characters.look: A short, stout, stiff-backed old queen of about sixty-five with a round double chin, a haughty little upturned nose, small sharp black eyes, thin pencilled eyebrows and pursed lips. Her silver-white hair is piled high in stiff curls under a heavy gold crown set with red stones. She wears a high-necked deep-purple velvet gown with a stiff white pleated collar, and holds a gold lorgnette on a stick for peering at people.

illustrations.anchor: Da han gikk hjem i skumringen, sto det en frue på stien mellom grantrærne.
illustrations.caption: Hun så så inderlig snill og god ut at mannen tok av seg lua.
illustrations.alt: I skumringen står en fattig mann på en sti mellom høye grantrær med lua i hendene. Foran ham står en fin frue i lang, lys kjole og dypblått slør og ser vennlig på ham.

Rules:
- No text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, signatures, captions, speech bubbles or logos.
- Every named character must match their model sheet and description exactly: the same face, hair, colours, clothes and proportions.
- Suitable for readers of all ages: no blood, wounds or gore, and no killing shown. Show danger and cruelty through atmosphere, posture and suspense, never through injury.
- Draw each named character only once.
- Show exactly the number of people, animals and things the description asks for, and no extra people.
- One clear moment that reads at a glance, as a single full-bleed picture with no border, frame or comic panels.
